answer.value: Germany leads in average startup funding at $173.9M, followed by USA ($153.8M) and France ($153.5M). All countries show balanced industry diversification with 8 industries each. AI industry attracts the highest average funding ($172.1M), while E-commerce has the lowest ($134.2M). The funding landscape shows developed markets (Germany, USA, France, Canada) attracting higher funding than emerging markets (Australia, UK), with consistent industry diversification across all countries.
